refnamediv.refpurpose: Default primitive polynomial of a given degree over GF(p)

listitem.para: Prime number: the characteristic of the field, at most 2^20.
Degree: an integer from 1 to 20, with p^n ≤ 2^20.
The primitive polynomial: a row of n + 1 coefficients, constant term first.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This is the polynomial that gf_create_field uses when no primitive polynomial is given.

listitem.para: For n = 1 it is x - g, where g is the smallest primitive root modulo p. Its coefficients are [p - g, 1] (for p = 2: [1 1]).

For n > 1 it is the first monic primitive polynomial c(1) + c(2) x + ... + c(n) x^(n-1) + x^n, when the candidates are taken in increasing order of c(1) + c(2) p + ... + c(n) p^(n-1) (the constant term changes fastest). It is therefore also the first row of gf_primitive_polynomials(p, n).

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting: gf_default_primitive_polynomial(2, 4) // [1 1 0 0 1]: 1 + x + x^4 gf_default_primitive_polynomial(2, 8) // [1 0 1 1 1 0 0 0 1] gf_default_primitive_polynomial(3, 2) // [2 1 1]: 2 + x + x^2 gf_default_primitive_polynomial(7, 1) // [4 1]: x - 3, 3 being the smallest primitive root mod 7

revdescription.para: Renamed from cf_devolver_pol_prim_def. Now available for any degree n.
